name: spork
description: Small, sharp, multi-purpose skills. /lean-spec writes, edits and validates superconcise, filler-free specs and technical docs at the right level of detail, keeps scope focused, and gates every doc with a two-pass alignment check and a 10-question litmus test. /shapeshot is schema-first: it agrees the exact output data shape with you before any work (brief, normalized outline, targeted questions, loop until it fits), locks it as a Zod 4 contract, fills it through a validate-and-repair pipeline, and presents it through data-driven JSON, Markdown or UI templates.
